headline: Iran's Guards Say Two Tankers Hit Mines In Strait Of Hormuz
summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards Navy said two oil tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines while crossing the Strait of Hormuz. The report was carried by Iranian state news agency.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a major chokepoint through which a large share of seaborne oil passes, so disruptions there move crude prices and shipping costs.
why_moved: Reported attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz raise concern about disruption to Gulf crude flows, which typically lifts oil prices and freight rates.
